operator_observation: The game crashed during loading, before the usual network alert. Do not repeat this build's manual trial.

game_process.interpretation: The historical startup reply was selected, decrypted and parsed; its commandid matched request ID1. The original newly generated iOS request token differed, while the authenticated historical reply token matched. The original result callback was invoked before the crash; no menu or gameplay was observed.

confirmed_cross_platform_cause: Authenticated historical Android SERVER.INIT has a nonzero timeout. Original iOS reads it as an integer at 0x180d60 and passes it to 0x1822c8, which captures the integer as a pointer for asynchronous worker cleanup 0x1c83b1. Worker map lookup dereferences address 1 at 0x1cfcf4. Original iOS zero-timeout branch skips the worker. The separately built iOS-adapted response retains historical identity but takes that zero-timeout branch; it has not been installed or device-tested.
rollback: Immediately upgraded in place to previously observed noncrashing ios/BirzzleFever-HB-offline-state-stages.ipa. No uninstall or repeat launch.
privacy: No raw logs, copied crash filenames, reply values, UID, token or member identifiers published.
